connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for Tor connection before giving up.

data_dir.description: Directory where received files are saved.

webhook_url.description: URL to send webhook notifications when files are received.

disable_text.description: Disable receiving text messages in receive mode.

disable_files.description: Disable receiving files in receive mode.

disable_csp.description: Disable the default Content Security Policy header in website mode.

custom_csp.description: Custom Content Security Policy header string for website mode.

no_autostop_sharing.description: Keep sharing active even after files are downloaded.

auto_start_timer.description: Delay in seconds before starting the onion service.

auto_stop_timer.description: Delay in seconds before stopping the onion service.
